name: Progress
summary: Two shapes — linear (default; 4 px tall stroke with optional label / value cluster) and circular (a ring; ideal for upload completion or small inline indicators). Renders determinate when value is provided, indeterminate when value is undefined. The brand stroke uses color.accent.500 — primary action and progress share the same hue because both represent forward motion. Distinct from Spinner (no value, ≤ 5 s).

value.description: 0-100. When undefined, renders an indeterminate sweep.

tone.description: accent: brand stroke (default). neutral: text.primary stroke. success/warning/danger: status.* stroke. Use neutral when progress sits inside a colored container (status banner) and the brand stroke would compete.

thickness.description: xs=2 / sm=4 / md=8 px linear height (or ring stroke for circular).

label.description: Visible label above the track. 'Uploading 12 of 24 files…'.

valueLabel.description: Visible value label right-aligned above/beside the track. '52%' or '4.2 MB / 8 MB'. If absent, computed from value/max.

showValue.description: When true and no valueLabel is supplied, derives 'NN%' from value/max.

size.description: circular shape only: sm=20 / md=32 / lg=48 / xl=72 px outer diameter.

rules: role='progressbar', aria-valuenow={value}, aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax={max}. Omit aria-valuenow when value is undefined (indeterminate).
aria-label describes what is loading ('Uploading files', 'Generating quote') — not just 'Progress'.
When value reaches max, the parent should announce completion via aria-live (Toast or status text).
Indeterminate sweep is paused under prefers-reduced-motion; the track shows a 50% fill with a 'Loading' sr-only label.

do: Use linear when the value is the most important state on the surface.
Use circular when progress is a small inline indicator (avatar upload, micro-task).
Always pair with a label that names what's loading.
Use tone='accent' as the default. Switch to neutral inside a status banner to avoid two competing colors.
Use indeterminate (no value) ONLY when you genuinely don't know — server response time, AI generation. If you can estimate, estimate.
dont: Don't reset the bar to 0% on retry. Always animate from current position.
Don't put two Progress bars side by side stacking the same task. Either one or split into named lanes.
Don't use Progress for a single < 1 s operation — use Spinner.
Don't paint the track in a status color and the bar in lime — keep both in the same family.

changelog.note: Initial Progress contract. Linear + circular shapes. Determinate + indeterminate. Four sizes (circular), three thicknesses (linear).
